event_name: Gerber Collision & Glass Route 66 NHRA Nationals presented by PEAK

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 83 degrees, relative humidity 58 percent, barometer 29.82 inches, adjusted
altitude 3,102 feet, track temperature 105 degrees.

Capps is 7 - 4 against Green in prior events. 

Capps with the starting line advantage.  They both cars are up in smoke right at the hit.  They both pedal the
car.  Green gets it to hook up enough to get the win.

Hagan is 33 - 26 against Beckman in prior events. 

Hagan with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.

Beckman is up in smoke right at the hit and clicked it off.

Prock is 7 - 3 against Todd in prior events. 

Todd with a slight starting line advantage, but was up in smoke right at the hit.  He pedaled it, but couldn't
chase Prock down.  Prock started to haze the tires around half track and drop cylinders.  He stays with it for
the win.  He will have lane choice over Green in the semifinal.

DeJoria and Richards have each won 3 times against the other in prior events. 

DeJoria with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  DeJoria is straight down the groove
with the quickest pass of the round.  she will have lane choice over Hagan in the semifinal.

Richards is up in smoke right at the hit and clicked it off.
